applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Miscellaneous) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Small finance banks must comply with the deletion of Section C on Limits for Non-Option Derivative Contracts.
answer.action_quote: Section C on ‘ Limits for Non -Option Derivative Contracts ’ of Chapter IV of the Reserve Bank of India ( Small Finance Banks - Miscellaneous) Directions, 2025 (paragraph 37 of the Directions) stands deleted.

effective_date.quote: The amended instructions shall come into effect immediately upon issuance.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Miscellaneous) Directions, 2025
